blocking_findings.evidence: Only client.file_dry(module, hot_plan, client_bindings) executes the real T2 fake opener/stream/execute loop, proving 36 calls. cold_a and cold_b are then constructed as dictionaries with fixed result/cached_tokens values. The receipt reports actual_mock_calls=60 without executing 24 cold request paths.
blocking_findings.impact: FILEdry does not validate the cold service request transport, per-call evidence capture, cold cache geometry judge, or compare inputs. It is a fabricated aggregate count under this review's requirement.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Drive both 12-call cold plans through the same fake start/request/judge path used by run_service/client.execute, recording each request and cache geometry; derive the 60 count from those calls.

blocking_findings.evidence: The admission checks only range-check each API/TCP port. bindable binds one port and closes it before the next probe; it never proves the six ports are unique nor holds a pair simultaneously until spawn.
blocking_findings.impact: A duplicate or racing port plan can pass admission/preflight and later classify as a harness failure without prior ownership proof.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Require six unique ports and API!=TCP in admission, use a simultaneous pair reservation/probe, and capture owner diagnostics on a bind failure.

blocking_findings.evidence: terminal.json is written before execute's finally block runs d07.require_gpu_idle and releases the lock. No post-finally artifact proves owned process groups are gone, GPU idle is true, ports are rebindable, or lock release completed.
blocking_findings.impact: The terminal result cannot close lifecycle/cleanup evidence even if measurements complete.
blocking_findings.required_resolution: Write a separate post-cleanup receipt after stop, idle, port and lock-release checks; retain the lock and emit explicit unsafe-cleanup state when any check fails.

test_evidence.limit: The tests assert the reported aggregate count and topology; they do not prove the two cold plans traversed request or judge code.
